capabilities.name: agent_visible_task_and_database_description
capabilities.source: DataAgent.__init__ initializes self.messages from the task request and supplied database description.
capabilities.unknown: No verified structured task decomposition or obligation IDs are exposed.

capabilities.name: registered_tool_dispatch_and_results
capabilities.source: DataAgent._handle_tool_call dispatches registered tools and appends a tool response to self.messages; success is local to the base method.
capabilities.unknown: The current hook has no general tool-success or task-relevance signal.

capabilities.name: model_response_and_terminal_boundary
capabilities.source: DataAgent.handle_reponse processes model tool calls; the G9 parent wraps the terminal path and distinguishes later model responses.
capabilities.unknown: A verified answer gate does not establish semantic answer checking.

capabilities.name: structured_obligation_evidence_binding
capabilities.source: No obligation-to-tool-event key was found in the G2 engineering review; the G9 parent has not been verified to add one.
capabilities.unknown: A safe synthetic binding design and its failure behavior remain to be established.

boundary_rule: The Research Meta may reason about source-verified capabilities, not read raw task content. A later runtime agent may use its own legal task, schema, and tool context only after an independent no-leak and protocol review.
